user.title: Add an HP printer
user.description: Enter the printer's address. Give it a name to control what its entities are called — leave it blank to use the model name.

data_description.host: Prefer the printer's mDNS name, such as NPI2E7F3D.local, which survives address changes. An IP address works too.
data_description.name: Used for the device and all of its entity IDs. Short names work best.

data_description.port: The embedded web server port. Leave at 80 and it will follow to 443 automatically if you turn on HTTPS.
data_description.ssl: Printers use a self-signed certificate, which is not verified.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure printer
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant reaches this printer. It must still be the same physical device.

zeroconf_confirm.title: HP printer found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {model} at {host}. Give it a name to control what its entities are called, or leave it blank to use the model name.

data_description.name: Used for the device and all of its entity IDs. Short names work best.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer. Check the address, and that the printer is powered on.
error.not_ledm: That host answered, but it does not look like an HP printer with a supported embedded web server.

abort.already_configured: This printer is already set up.
abort.serial_mismatch: That address belongs to a different printer than the one this entry was created for.
abort.cannot_connect: Found a printer, but could not read from it. It may be asleep, or it may not support the management interface this integration uses.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to read the printer. Printers sleep between jobs and polling wakes them, so slower is gentler on the device.

serial_mismatch.message: {device} reported a different serial number than expected. The address may now belong to another printer.
